bootstrap_ci_gate.rank_bound: At B1000 and q.025/.975, NumPy linear percentile lies between order ranks(25,26)/(975,976), one-based. Bound lower-rank CDF using Beta(rank,B+1-rank) quantile .025/(2*76), upper rank using1-that; inverse-binomial order-statistic bounds fixed without data.
bootstrap_ci_gate.reference_error: Uniform empirical reference CDF DKW bound epsilon=sqrt(log(2*76/.025)/(2*1e6))=.0020871942859925874; subtract/add to fixed order-rank probability bounds. Use empirical generalized inverse (NumPy inverted_cdf) at resulting fixed probability levels.
bootstrap_ci_gate.pass: Every original bootstrap endpoint must lie in its independently generated reference envelope plus/minus fixed1e-4 vector-extraction tolerance. Means/tests/effects remain strict. Failures are reported; no widening, alternate quantile algorithm, new draw count, seed selection or plot-target-guided change.
